# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

## Blast-radius map (verified structural fact, use every iteration)
- Task 37 is the ONLY passing val task. It writes via cancel_reservation + update_reservation_flights only, and never transfers. Therefore edits to book_reservation, update_reservation_passengers, update_reservation_baggages, and transfer_to_human_agents are zero-blast-radius on the passing set BY CONSTRUCTION. Edits to cancel_reservation or update_reservation_flights are NOT — treat those as high risk.

## The 9 failing tasks are mostly "write never attempted", not "write attempted wrong"
- Confirmed by reading traces: 11 transfers on turn 1; 40 transfers over a dob that is already on the reservation; 17 transfers thinking cancel-criteria unmet (gold is a cabin-change modify); 8 transfers after can't-find-flight; 25 searches return [] then user asks for a human; 19 runs out of turns right before a correct cancel; 22 works the WRONG reservation (UM3OG5 vs gold FQ8APE); 12 derails into a cabin-budget discussion (gold is add-baggage). Only 23 emits a book call, and it fails on payment_id format + dob key + sum — but 23 also needs a cancel + THREE separate bookings with a different itinerary, so a format fix alone cannot flip it.
- Implication for future iterations: do NOT spend edits normalizing tools the agent never calls. The high-value move is intercepting the transfer (the substitute call) — pending gate confirmation from cand_0001.
- Promising but not yet tried (needs a RESULT first): per-family redirect wording in the transfer block; a composite "modify_reservation" atomic tool that the transfer-block funnels toward.
